draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Malleshwaram! One of Bangalore's oldest neighbourhoods, it was laid out by the Wadiyars of Mysore and gets called the city's cultural heart.
draft.hungryLine: Kanti Sweets has a branch at Malleswaram Circle, and it's known for samosas, kachoris and North Indian sweets like rasmalai.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Sri Gangamma Devi Temple is a 3 minute walk, and the Nandi Tirtha temple is 7 minutes away on 2nd Temple Street.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Stroll 2nd Temple Street, where the Gangamma temple, Nandi Tirtha and Kadu Malleshwara temple sit close together.
moodReplies.surprise-me: A 10th century hero stone commemorating a tiger hunt was found on the grounds of the Indian Institute of Science, right here in Malleshwaram.

spots.name: Sri Gangamma Devi Temple
spots.detail: 3 min walk · Temple to the goddess Ganga

spots.name: Sri Dakshinamukha Nandi Tirtha Kalyani Kshetra
spots.detail: 7 min walk · Shiva temple opposite Kadu Malleshwara

spots.name: Mantri Square
spots.detail: 19 min walk · One of the biggest malls in the country

legends.title: A temple under the ground
legends.body: Locals call it Malleswaram Nandi gudi. It was rediscovered in 1997 after being buried for 400 years, and it's revered as the holy source of the Vrishabhavati river.

tips.title: Take the metro in.
tips.body: Mantri Square Sampige Road station has a bridge straight into the mall, the first of its kind in India.

tips.title: Dress modestly on Temple Street.
tips.body: Several old temples line 2nd Temple Street, including Kadu Malleshwara, which gives the area its name.

story.title: A tiger hunt
story.body: A hero stone found at IISc remembers a tiger hunt from the 10th century.

story.title: Ekoji's gift
story.body: Maratha king Ekoji I gave the village of Medaraninganahalli to the Mallapura Mallikarjuna temple.

story.title: A planned layout
story.body: The Wadiyars of Mysore laid out Malleshwaram as a new residential area after a plague epidemic.

story.title: Nandi Tirtha found
story.body: The buried Nandi Tirtha temple was rediscovered after about 400 years.

story.title: Metro and mall
story.body: Sampige Road metro station opened in March 2014, and its bridge into Mantri Square opened that August.
